name: tiktoken_import
description: Imports the tiktoken library for tokenization.

name: text_splitter_import
description: Imports the RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter class from langchain's text_splitter module.

name: tiktoken_len_function
description: Defines a function to calculate the token length of the provided text using the tiktoken library.

name: tiktoken_len_tokenization
description: Calls the tiktoken encoding function to tokenize the input text.

name: tiktoken_len_return
description: Returns the length of the tokenized text.

name: text_splitter_initialization
description: Initializes a RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter instance with specified parameters.
full_code:
text_splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(
    chunk_size = 750,
    chunk_overlap = 0,
    length_function = tiktoken_len,
)

name: loan_knowledge_chunks_variable
description: Calls the split_documents method on the text_splitter to process loan knowledge resources into chunks.
